This is more of a guide so you don't have to go through customer service. Not that customer service is bad, it's actually quite amazing but this might save you some time.

Even if you change your default SMS app it won't receive texts (didn't for me at least) until I did as follows:

  • In Hangouts go to Settings -> SMS -> (Under General) -> Set Default SMS app
  • Go back into Settings, then select your primary Google account look for Project Fi Calls And SMS - (Your Number)
  • Uncheck the box labeled Messages and your new SMS app should now work!

(If any of the above information is wrong please notify me)
Switching from Hangouts to another SMS app.
